name: GlzAuroraSurface
semanticRole: Highlight exceptional intelligent or expressive content using a neutral readable surface with restrained ambient Aurora underlay while keeping foreground text and controls high contrast.

material.rule: Aurora is an ambient underlay on a readable neutral surface rather than translucent wallpaper. Subtle uses roughly 8–10% ambient color, standard 10–16%, and hero 16–24%; hero is rare.

input.keyboard: Keyboard operation follows the component's semantic role; no required action depends on pointer-only interaction.
input.focus: Focus is visible, deterministic, and restored or moved according to the component's spatial transformation.
input.hover: Hover may enrich presentation but never exposes the only path to essential information or actions.
input.press: Press feedback is immediate and does not wait for decorative animation before semantic state changes.

accessibility.role: Use region/article/group semantics according to content, with generated or intelligent identity exposed in text rather than color or gradient alone.
accessibility.name: The surface has a meaningful label when it forms a standalone region; nested actions and sources remain individually named.
accessibility.state: Expose busy, expanded, selected, and generated-content state through semantics and visible text.
accessibility.value: The surface itself has no synthetic value; confidence/progress values, when present, use explicit nested semantics.
accessibility.keyboard: All contained actions and sources are keyboard reachable in logical order; decorative Aurora layers are ignored by assistive technology.
accessibility.focus: Focus indicators render above ambient layers and never rely on glow alone.
accessibility.errorAssociation: Errors remain associated with the affected control or content and are announced without color-only meaning.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Replace spatial morphing with direct state changes or a short crossfade while preserving the same capability.
accessibility.reducedTransparency: Replace translucent material with an opaque surface while preserving hierarchy and boundaries.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Strengthen focus, boundaries, selected state, and text contrast without changing semantics.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use system colors, visible focus, and remove decorative gradients, blur, and shadows.
accessibility.largeText: Reflow at 200% text without clipping essential labels, actions, sources, or state.

fallbacks.reducedMotion: Replace spatial morphing with direct state changes or a short crossfade while preserving the same capability.
fallbacks.reducedTransparency: Replace translucent material with an opaque surface while preserving hierarchy and boundaries.
fallbacks.highContrast: Strengthen focus, boundaries, selected state, and text contrast without changing semantics.
fallbacks.forcedColors: Use system colors, visible focus, and remove decorative gradients, blur, and shadows.
fallbacks.performance: Remove blur, ambient gradients, decorative shadows, and nonessential morphing before changing semantic structure, target geometry, focus, or readable contrast.

content.overflow: Long intelligent content reflows on a readable base; source/action rows wrap and hero styling never forces clipping.
content.localization: Labels, generated-state copy, sources, and actions tolerate 30–50% expansion.
content.rtl: Ambient decoration may remain atmospheric, but text, source order, and actions use logical RTL layout.

criteria: Ambient color remains subordinate to readable neutral content.
Subtle/standard/hero intensity is visibly disciplined and hero is exceptional.
Forced Colors and Reduced Transparency remove decorative Aurora without losing intelligent/generated identity.
